description: Contains the GameLogic class with static methods for tic-tac-toe game mechanics.

classes.name: GameLogic
classes.description: A class that contains static methods to manage game logic for tic-tac-toe.

methods.name: Optional[str] check_winner(board: List[List[Optional[str]]])
methods.description: Checks the game board for a winner and returns the player's identifier if found.

methods.name: bool is_draw(board: List[List[Optional[str]]])
methods.description: Checks if the game is a draw by verifying that all cells are filled.

methods.name: bool is_valid_move(board: List[List[Optional[str]]], row: int, col: int)
methods.description: Verifies if a move is valid by checking the bounds and if the cell is empty.

methods.name: Tuple[List[List[Optional[str]]],bool] make_move(board: List[List[Optional[str]]], row: int, col: int, player: str)
methods.description: Updates the game board with the player's move and returns the updated board and success flag.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[str],bool] get_game_status(board: List[List[Optional[str]]])
methods.description: Determines the current game status including winner and if it's a draw.
